project.boundarySource: Curated visitor envelope derived from the OpenStreetMap settlement point, with adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 2 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 14 of 18 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Hodnet qualifies as a local detour through Motte and bailey castle on Castle Hill, and the associated remains of a park pale, a fishpond and a formal garden and CHURCH OF ST LUKE. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Hodnet: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Hodnet offers Motte and bailey castle on Castle Hill, and the associated remains of a park pale, a fishpond and a formal garden, CHURCH OF ST LUKE within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.
